summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — CNA.L +4%, AV.L +3%, UMG.AS +3%, ABF.L +2%, AD.AS +2%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (IFX.DE -4%, ASM.AS -4%, PCT.L -3%, MT.AS -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: IFX.DE (-4.29%) — no obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-16 — likely a technical / sector move, probably a semiconductor or AI-chip pullback. Searches turned up no dated company news. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: IFX.DE is a large-cap German (Xetra) semiconductor, and no strategy's universe includes it. With no identifiable news, a news-reactive strategy would also have had no trigger.
